templates.name: Trial check-in
templates.text: Hey {{first_name}}, this is {{staff}} from {{location}}! Just checking in to see how your trial is going so far. Let me know if you have any questions or want to book a time to come back in!

templates.name: Missed call follow-up
templates.text: Hi {{first_name}}, this is {{staff}} from {{location}} - sorry I missed your call! What can I help you with? Feel free to call/text back anytime.

templates.name: Appointment reminder
templates.text: Hi {{first_name}}, this is {{staff}} from {{location}} confirming your appointment on {{appointment_date}}. Reply YES to confirm or let me know if you need to reschedule!

templates.name: Re-engagement (cold lead)
templates.text: Hey {{first_name}}, it's {{staff}} from {{location}}. It's been a bit since we last connected - we'd love to have you back in! Let me know if you're still interested and I can get you set up.

templates.name: Welcome / new member
templates.text: Welcome to {{location}}, {{first_name}}! This is {{staff}} - excited to have you as a member. Let me know if you ever have questions, and see you at the gym!

templates.name: No-show follow-up
templates.text: Hey {{first_name}}, this is {{staff}} from {{location}} - we missed you at your appointment on {{appointment_date}}! No worries at all, just let me know a better time and I'll get you rebooked.

templates.name: Free trial pass follow-up
templates.text: Hi {{first_name}}, this is {{staff}} from {{location}}! Wanted to make sure your free trial pass came through okay - come in anytime and I'll show you around. Any day works!

templates.name: Post-first-workout check-in
templates.text: Hey {{first_name}}, {{staff}} here from {{location}} - how'd your first workout go? Let me know if you're feeling sore or have any questions, happy to help!

templates.name: Membership renewal reminder
templates.text: Hi {{first_name}}, this is {{staff}} from {{location}}. Just a heads up that your membership is coming up for renewal - let me know if you'd like to go over your options anytime!

templates.name: Membership expired win-back
templates.text: Hey {{first_name}}, it's {{staff}} from {{location}}. Noticed your membership lapsed - we'd love to have you back! Let me know if you want to talk through options, no pressure at all.

templates.name: Referral thank-you
templates.text: Hi {{first_name}}, this is {{staff}} from {{location}} - thank you so much for referring a friend! We really appreciate it. Let me know if there's ever anything you need.

templates.name: Birthday message
templates.text: Happy birthday, {{first_name}}! This is {{staff}} from {{location}} wishing you a great one. Come celebrate with a workout on us if you're free this week!

templates.name: Billing / payment reminder
templates.text: Hi {{first_name}}, this is {{staff}} from {{location}}. Looks like there was an issue processing your last payment - could you give us a call or stop by when you get a chance? Thanks!

templates.name: Collections outreach (friendly)
templates.text: Hi {{first_name}}, this is {{staff}} from {{location}}. Reaching out about your account balance - totally understand things come up. Let me know what works for you and we'll get it sorted out.

templates.name: Insurance paperwork follow-up
templates.text: Hey {{first_name}}, this is {{staff}} from {{location}}. Just following up on the insurance paperwork for your membership - let me know if you have any questions or need help getting it submitted!

templates.name: Relocating / not local follow-up
templates.text: Hi {{first_name}}, this is {{staff}} from {{location}}. Heard you might be moving out of the area - wanted to check in on your membership. Happy to help figure out next steps whenever you're ready.

templates.name: Holiday hours notice
templates.text: Hi {{first_name}}, this is {{staff}} from {{location}}! Just a heads up that our hours are a little different for the holiday - let us know if you have any questions about the schedule.

templates.name: New class or program announcement
templates.text: Hey {{first_name}}, {{staff}} here from {{location}} - we just added a new class we think you'd love! Let me know if you want the schedule or want to try it out.

templates.name: Long time no see check-in
templates.text: Hey {{first_name}}, this is {{staff}} from {{location}} - haven't seen you in a bit! Just checking in to see how you're doing and if there's anything we can help with.

templates.name: Personal training offer
templates.text: Hi {{first_name}}, this is {{staff}} from {{location}}. Thought you might be interested in a personal training session to help hit your goals faster - want me to set one up for you?
